LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Torii.label: torii gate
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Torii.description: A tall red gate of two pillars and two lintels. Walking beneath it, people lower their voices.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Lantern.label: stone lantern
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Lantern.description: A carved stone lantern with a small flame inside. It lights a garden path softly through the night.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaTable.label: tea table
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaTable.description: A low dark table set with an iron kettle and four cups. Colonists kneel around it for a quiet cup of tea.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Dojo.label: dojo training post
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Dojo.description: A post wrapped in straw bundles. Colonists strike it again and again to train their sword arm.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Rack.label: katana rack
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Rack.description: A lacquered rack holding swords in their scabbards. A proud display of a house's blades.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura_Gun.label: tower bows
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura_Gun.description: The turning top of the yagura.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura.label: yagura
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura.description: A small timber watchtower with white plaster walls. Three bows set on a turning frame loose a short volley at once. Wood for new arrows: one log makes two.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaUrn.label: electric tea urn
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaUrn.description: A tall urn of black-lacquered copper on a stand, heated by a coil and kept just below the boil all day, with a tray of cups beside it. Colonists gather at it to share tea.
